title: A Multilingual, Large-Scale Study of the Interplay between LLM Safeguards, Personalisation, and Disinformation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the trigger rates of LLM safety mechanisms (jailbreaks, disclaimers, refusals) in response to disinformation prompts, where 'religious' was one of the news frames used to categorize the prompt topics.
findings: Disinformation narratives framed with religious topics, along with health-safety and crime, elicited the highest refusal rates from the tested Large Language Models, indicating that these topics are more likely to trigger safety mechanisms compared to frames like justice and economy.
